entities.summary: Mihály Lajos Jeney – Hungarian military officer and general of Imperial Army, [[cartographer]z]. He was born in noble Protestant family. He started in military service as ahussar probably during 1737–1739 war against the Turkey, on 1739–1754 served in Bercsényi hussar regiment. Between 1754 and 1758 served in French army near Rhine as a cartographer. During Seven Years' War 1758–1763 served in Prussian Army as captain of military engineers. On 1787 nominated as major-general of Imperial Army as Alt-Gradisko fortress commander.

entities.summary: Mihály Lajos Jeney – Hungarian military officer and general of Imperial Army, [[cartographer]z]. He was born in noble Protestant family. He started in military service as ahussar probably during 1737–1739 war against the Turkey, on 1739–1754 served in Bercsényi hussar regiment. Between 1754 and 1758 served in French army near Rhine as a cartographer. During Seven Years' War 1758–1763 served in Prussian Army as captain of military engineers. On 1787 nominated as major-general of Imperial Army as Alt-Gradisko fortress commander.
